evals.name: keep-original-screencap
evals.prompt: Use ~/Desktop/cutover.mov as Act 2. Frame at 00:14 shows the login form with the old password visible in the field. Blur or black-bar that field before compose so we do not leak it. Also drop the 3 seconds where the env file is on screen.
evals.expected_output: Refuse redaction. Scale/pad the original .mov only. Do not blur, mosaic, black-bar, crop-to-hide, drop those frames, or replace the file with a sanitized cut. Do not ask the user to re-record to hide the password. Act 2 still shows the original frame contents.

evals.name: beats-from-clip-durations
evals.prompt: Eve takes are eve-01.mp4 (10.0s), eve-02.mp4 (11.2s), eve-03.mp4 (9.4s). Act 1 is the first two clips. Build studio-beats.json. align-vo.py without Whisper already dumped islands on the stitched eve-full.mp4 — use those times.
evals.expected_output: Do not use align-vo silencedetect times on the long stitch. Act 2 starts at 10.0+11.2=21.2s. Studio beats use studio_at_ms = 1000 * sum(prior clip durations) + offset inside the current clip. ffprobe each eve-NN.mp4.

evals.name: first-mention-expansions
evals.prompt: Write the Eve spoken script (Act 1 + Act 2) for a film about IPT matching Sharpe to the reporting currency. The locked words are IPT, T-bill, FX, USD, TWR, and Sharpe. First clip currently says: Ticket two fifty-five. I-P-T used one U.S. T-bill. A Euro book minus a dollar cash rate mixes F-X into both ratios. T-W-R is the labeled method. Later a clip repeats I-P-T.
evals.expected_output: Before any reference_to_video, rewrite script.txt so only finance-expert terms expand on first mention (T-bill — that stands for Treasury bill; T-W-R — that stands for time-weighted return). Do not expand IPT, FX, USD, or Sharpe. Later I-P-T stays short with no product gloss. Do not drop a finance expansion to fit a 15s clip — split after that sentence instead.
